svg.title: Six modalities on one shared time axis
svg.desc: Synthetic illustration, invented values, no recording: six labelled lanes for speech, language, acoustics, vision, speakers and stories share one axis in seconds from video start and feed one dataset directory of Parquet tables, raw tool output, provenance and an ELAN export.
